description: Reproducible systematic-search and screening workflow with explicit eligibility criteria, stable record deduplication, and an auditable decision trail.

rules.reason: A systematic-review stage requires protocol-driven search, screening, and deduplication.

interface.short_description: Run a traceable systematic search and screening process.
interface.long_description: Defines eligibility and search boundaries, deduplicates records, preserves screening decisions, and reports coverage without claiming inaccessible databases were searched.
interface.default_prompt: Help me define and run a reproducible systematic-review workflow.
